census.scope: Only the 38 IDL instruction dispatch wrapper windows and their relocation patterns. Direct call immediates and relocation addresses are normalized; callee bodies, target semantics, transitive closure, parser correctness, runtime behavior, the entrypoint dispatcher, generated IDL-management instructions, and whole-ELF identity are excluded.
